NOTIFICATIONS
Ohio County conducts monthly tornado siren tests on the first Wednesday of each month at 12:00 PM and 7:00 PM, from March through November, weather permitting.
If severe weather is possible at the time of the scheduled test, the test will be canceled or postponed.
